overrides.observed: PDF-to-markdown conversion damage across the file: 131 dice expressions with OCR 'I' for '1' ('Id6'), 4 '+I' enhancement bonuses, the Blowgun's lone 'I Piercing' damage, the 'Rolling 20 or I' heading, 1 CR line joined onto a Languages line, 4 'n XP' orderings, and 91 damaged monster ability tables (roman-numeral scores, LaTeX-wrapped labels, glued label-score cells, and systematically truncated CON/CHA modifier and save columns).
overrides.proposed: Applied by scripts/repair_source.py using the substitution glossary in scripts/data/sanitization-glossary.json. 89 ability tables were regenerated from open5e's srd-2024 dataset (CC-BY-4.0, scripts/data/srd-2024-creatures.json) with cross-validation against every intact source cell; 2 spell-summoned stat blocks absent from that dataset (Giant Insect, Draconic Spirit) had their truncated modifier/save cells derived from the printed score via floor((score-10)/2), matching every intact column in those tables. The repair is idempotent; re-running reports zero changes.
overrides.rationale: The user directed repair of all known source damage. The pre-repair file digest was sha256-651440c82e5f30ff76469e5a9e589bfca91b17945e581126547a61261a79e042; the final post-repair digest (after the follow-up level-I/level-II and DI0 glossary passes) is sha256-c7119f099c3a62baee84ceb413790d4facf7c634a22bb406ca19c85020ccee12, carried by the source record.

overrides.observed: The markdown contains 17 feats including 7 Epic Boons. An earlier audit flagged 3 boons as possibly dropped by the PDF conversion; cross-checking against the official SRD 5.2 coverage and open5e's srd-2024 dataset (identical 17 feats) confirmed the SRD intentionally includes only 7 of the Player's Handbook's 10 Epic Boons.
overrides.proposed: No change: the catalog is complete relative to the source.
overrides.rationale: Retracts the withdrawn `missing-epic-boon-feats` suspicion; kept as an audit record.

overrides.observed: open5e srd-2024 lists the Octopus with CON 0 and CHA -3 (its modifiers duplicated into the score fields). The SRD source prints CON 11, CHA 4 and its table is intact.
overrides.proposed: Trust the source; the repair script only regenerates damaged tables, so the intact Octopus table was left verbatim.
overrides.rationale: Documents why cross-validation is scoped to damaged tables only.
